title: Fleet Operations
description: Answers the live half of the business question: utilisation and earnings by area, right now. Fed by the speed layer (realtime_zone_metrics, vehicle_status, idle_alerts) plus the batch layer's latest profitability day.

panels.title: Active vehicles (latest window)
panels.description: Vehicles with status enroute or on_trip in the most recent 1-minute speed-layer window.

panels.title: Idle ratio
panels.description: idle_vehicles / total_vehicles in the latest window. Above 0.5 means half the fleet is earning nothing.

panels.title: Trips completed (last 60 min)
panels.description: Count of trip-end events, which are the only events carrying a fare.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(trips_completed),0) AS trips FROM realtime_zone_metrics WHERE window_start > now() - interval '60 minutes';

panels.title: Earnings last 60 min (LKR)
panels.description: Sum of fares in the last hour of wall-clock time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(earnings_lkr),0) AS earnings FROM realtime_zone_metrics WHERE window_start > now() - interval '60 minutes';

panels.title: Open idle alerts
panels.description: Vehicles idle for longer than IDLE_ALERT_MINUTES with no resolution yet.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::int AS open_alerts FROM idle_alerts WHERE status = 'open';

panels.title: Earnings by zone (1-minute windows)
panels.description: Speed layer output: fare sum per zone per tumbling window on event_time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time, zone AS metric, earnings_lkr AS value FROM realtime_zone_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Active vs idle vehicles by zone
panels.description: Utilisation over time. A zone whose idle count dominates is over-supplied.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time, zone || ' active' AS metric, active_vehicles AS value FROM realtime_zone_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) ORDER BY 1;
SELECT window_start AS time, zone || ' idle' AS metric, idle_vehicles AS value FROM realtime_zone_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Open idle alerts (threshold rule)
panels.description: The brief's required threshold alert: vehicle idle longer than IDLE_ALERT_MINUTES.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.vehicle_id, a.zone, a.idle_since, a.detected_at, round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - a.idle_since))/60.0, 1) AS idle_minutes, a.status FROM idle_alerts a WHERE a.status = 'open' ORDER BY a.idle_since ASC LIMIT 25;

panels.title: Unprofitable / at-risk vehicles (latest reconciled day)
panels.description: Batch layer output: the second half of the business question. Rows come from daily_vehicle_profitability after the Airflow DAG has joined telemetry with the expense file.

targets.rawSql: SELECT report_date, vehicle_id, revenue_lkr, total_cost_lkr, profit_lkr, round(margin,3) AS margin, trend, data_quality_flag FROM v_unprofitable_vehicles LIMIT 25;

panels.title: Earnings by simulated hour of day (latest batch day)
panels.description: Time-of-day analysis from the batch layer, grouped on the SIMULATED clock so a full 24 h profile exists after one 10-minute simulated day.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sim_hour, zone, sum(earnings_lkr) AS earnings FROM daily_zone_summary WHERE report_date = (SELECT max(report_date) FROM daily_zone_summary) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1;
